title: UI: Timeline and Stage global keydown handlers double-fire (Delete deletes both frame and stage object)
description: Fixed: single Delete/Enter/Ctrl+C/X/V keypress no longer double-fires between the Timeline panel and Stage/global handlers. Added data-timeline-panel marker + shared isTimelinePanelFocused() (dispatch/timelineFocus.ts), mirroring isWithinRufflePlayer. StageArea Enter/Delete/clipboard handlers early-return when the Timeline is focused; useCommandKeyboard yields ONLY Timeline-owned bindings (isTimelineOwnedBinding) so undo/redo/group/duplicate/text still work while Timeline focused. VERIFY: 'pnpm --filter ./packages/** build' exit 0; 'pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui test --run' => 104 files, 1226 tests, all pass (new: timelineFocus.test.ts 5, keyboardTimelineFocus.test.ts 5, keyboardBindings isTimelineOwnedBinding 7). docs/20-timeline-ui-layout.md updated (Keyboard focus ownership).
